name: Bettermode
description: Bettermode is a hosted customer-community platform for discussions, knowledge sharing, ideation, engagement, spaces, memberships, events, customization, and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-generated access token to one fixed US or EU GraphQL endpoint, one exact Network, and one exact dedicated least-privilege member. Agents can inspect reduced Network, member, Space, and Post metadata and make exact one-member Space membership changes through eight fixed GraphQL documents. Content, communication, moderation, lifecycle, administration, bulk operations, private identity, bot tokens, and arbitrary GraphQL remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: BETTERMODE_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Bettermode region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter us for api.bettermode.com or eu for api.bettermode.de. Relay accepts no custom GraphQL origin.

credentialRequirements.name: BETTERMODE_NETWORK_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Bettermode Network ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact Network ID the access token is intended to operate in.

credentialRequirements.name: BETTERMODE_MEMBER_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Bettermode integration member ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact dedicated least-privilege member ID represented by the access token. Relay rejects bot or different-member tokens.

credentialRequirements.name: BETTERMODE_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Bettermode access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Provide a customer-generated app or member access token bound to the exact dedicated member. Relay encrypts it, never exposes it to agents or clients after saving, and sends it only as a Bearer header.

capabilities.label: Read Network catalog

capabilities.label: Read members

allowed.label: Read connected member

allowed.label: List spaces

approvalRequired.label: List members
approvalRequired.description: List up to twenty-five reduced member identity, status, role, and contribution summaries without email, profile, session, activity, URL, or raw data.

approvalRequired.label: List space members

approvalRequired.label: List post metadata
approvalRequired.description: List up to twenty-five reduced Post lifecycle and engagement summaries without content, author identity, media, URLs, mentions, or raw fields.

approvalRequired.label: Add space member

approvalRequired.label: Remove space member

blocked.label: Read or write content
blocked.description: Post and reply bodies, short content, descriptions, custom fields, drafts, private messages, embeds, files, media, attachments, mentions, reactions, topics, events, and arbitrary rich content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Manage member lifecycle
blocked.description: Creating, inviting, updating, verifying, suspending, blocking, deleting, impersonating another member, changing Network roles, or changing profile and authentication data is outside V1.

blocked.label: Administer network structure
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, reordering, or configuring Networks, Spaces, Collections, Space roles, Post types, Tags, Topics, Badges, apps, themes, webhooks, SSO, settings, plans, and site state is outside V1.

blocked.label: Moderate community
blocked.description: Hiding, locking, pinning, archiving, deleting, reviewing, reporting, blocking, or otherwise moderating Posts, replies, members, and Spaces is outside V1.

blocked.label: Communicate or notify
blocked.description: Creating Posts or replies, private messaging, email, invitations, notifications, broadcasts, reactions, and outbound webhooks are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run bulk or analytics actions
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, multi-member membership mutations, bulk loops, polling, exports, imports, analytics, quota probing, logs, and historical reloads are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read broader identity data
blocked.description: Emails, external IDs, profile fields, extra properties, sessions, blocked-member graphs, avatars, banners, locations, locale, last-seen or verification activity, and raw member records are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Bettermode GraphQL
blocked.description: Arbitrary queries, mutations, fields, variables, aliases, fragments, batching, introspection, alternate endpoints, guest or login token generation, app-token generation, bot tokens, raw responses, webhooks, Liquid, CLI, and direct database access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Exact Network, connected-member, and Space catalog reads run directly. Network/Space member identity, Post metadata, and all Space membership changes require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All eight selected bounded Bettermode V1 tools run without Relay per-action approval; encrypted credentials, exact region/Network/member binding, provider authority, fixed GraphQL documents, bounds, audits, privacy reduction, and system blocks still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: No representative Bettermode Network, dedicated integration member, member-bound access token, or staging Space/member/Post fixtures were available for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Bettermode customer creates or selects a dedicated least-privilege integration member, generates a current app or member access token representing that exact member rather than the default admin-capable bot, and enters the fixed region, exact Network ID, exact member ID, and token in Relay. Staging acceptance verifies Network and actor binding, reduced projections, Safe approval binding, Dangerous execution, representative exact-member Space add/remove cycles, complexity and rate errors, token expiry and rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Bettermode's official GraphQL reference requires Bearer access tokens, accepts POST only, and fixes the regional endpoints to api.bettermode.com for US and api.bettermode.de for EU.

App access tokens can represent a specific member or an admin-capable bot when no member is supplied, require a published and installed app, and expire; Relay requires an exact dedicated member and blocks token generation and bot tokens.
Bettermode documents fixed query documents, variables, mandatory connection limits, node projections, and the members and spaces connection shapes used by Relay.
The official tutorial documents members and spaceMembers as paginated queries and the member and Space-role relationship used by Relay's reduced projections.
The official schema documents the bounded posts connection, optional Space restriction, offset pagination, and Post fields selected by Relay's metadata-only wrapper.
Bettermode documents addSpaceMembers and removeSpaceMembers; Relay constrains their array-capable provider shapes to exactly one validated existing member and one validated Space per approved call.
Bettermode applies burst and daily request and complexity quotas by plan, returns HTTP 429 and Retry-After on denial, and reports complexity in GraphQL response extensions.
Bettermode's privacy policy distinguishes subscriber and end-user data and states that each customer community publishes the policy governing information collected in that community.
